DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal CASCADE;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal AS
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(data, 'YYYY-MM')       AS ano_mes,
  EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM data)::int  AS ano,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM data)::int  AS mes,
  filial_nome,
  filial_estado,
  filial_regiao,
  grupo_veiculo,
  COUNT(*)                       AS qtd_passagens,
  COUNT(DISTINCT placa)          AS qtd_veiculos,
  ROUND(SUM(valor)::numeric, 2)  AS total_valor,
  ROUND(AVG(valor)::numeric, 4)  AS ticket_medio
FROM torre.gold_truckpag_pedagio
WHERE filial_nome IS NOT NULL
  AND placa_tipo IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
WITH DATA;

CREATE INDEX idx_mv_kpis_ped_mensal_ano_mes
  ON torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal (ano_mes);

CREATE INDEX idx_mv_kpis_ped_mensal_filial
  ON torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal (filial_nome);

CREATE INDEX idx_mv_kpis_ped_mensal_grupo_veic
  ON torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal (grupo_veiculo);

SELECT 'MV gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal criada' AS status;

-- Totais gerais
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT ano_mes)                    AS meses,
  COUNT(*)                                   AS linhas_mv,
  SUM(qtd_passagens)                         AS total_passagens,
  SUM(qtd_veiculos)                          AS total_veiculos_mes,
  ROUND(SUM(total_valor)::numeric, 2)        AS total_gasto,
  ROUND(AVG(ticket_medio)::numeric, 4)       AS ticket_medio_geral
FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal;

-- Últimos 3 meses por grupo_veiculo
SELECT
  ano_mes,
  grupo_veiculo,
  SUM(qtd_passagens)                         AS passagens,
  SUM(qtd_veiculos)                          AS veiculos,
  ROUND(SUM(total_valor)::numeric, 2)        AS total,
  ROUND(
    SUM(total_valor) / NULLIF(SUM(qtd_passagens), 0)
  ::numeric, 4)                              AS ticket_medio
FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_mensal
WHERE ano_mes >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months', 'YYYY-MM')
GROUP BY ano_mes, grupo_veiculo
ORDER BY ano_mes DESC, total DESC;
